0.description: He's young, he's stylish, and he knows all the moves! The soul of the party and the king of the dance floor─Dancing Green!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07210_000020_METEM
1.description: The ring is her studio, and reality her canvas! She's the rebel with a cause who captivates all with her illusions─Sugar Riot!

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07210_000030_METEM
2.description: He's back for revenge─with a vengeance! The despicable fighter formerly known as the Brute Bomber─the Brute Abombinator!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07210_000040_METEM
3.description: With his peerless bladework and preternatural agility, he's the apex predator of the cruiserweight division─the Howling Blade!
